test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word. 

Provoke
solution:
The correct answer is option 3 Arouse. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**Provoke means to incite or stimulate a reaction or feeling in someone.

__
 
• Arouse is a synonym of provoke and means to awaken or excite a feeling or emotion in someone.
 
• Inhibit means to hinder or restrain someone from doing something.
 
• Stack means to pile or arrange things in a neat or orderly manner.
 
• Constrain means to limit or restrict someone's actions or behavior.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Provoke is often used in the context of causing anger or irritation in someone.
 
• Arouse can be used in a broader sense to refer to any kind of emotional or physical stimulation.
 
• Inhibit is the opposite of provoke and means to prevent or discourage a certain behavior or action.
 
• Stack and constrain are not related to the meaning of provoke."
